items.title: Bessent announces campaign to cut Iran from global economy; Tehran vows response

items.title: Raymond James cuts airline estimates on higher fuel, upgrades Allegiant
items.summary: Investing.com -- Raymond James lowered estimates across its airline coverage universe, citing a higher jet fuel price forecast, while upgrading Allegiant Travel to Strong Buy from Outperform. The carrier’s shares rose more than 2% in premarket trading.

items.title: Iran warns neighbours against joining U.S. sanctions as Hormuz stays closed
items.summary: Investing.com -- Iran warned neighbouring states that joining Washington’s planned sanctions campaign would make them enemies and expose their interests to retaliation, Al Jazeera reported Sunday, citing security chief Mohsen Rezaei.
